name: TBCC weekly ship log tick
description: Monday 09:00 — draft from git, post Buffer Idea or queue X on milestone. Zero manual /ship-log.

prompts.prompt:
TBCC automated ship log tick (no user commands).

1. cd tbcc/backend
2. py -3.13 scripts/run_ship_log_tick.py
3. If exit non-zero, report stderr only.
4. Output: action taken (skip | idea | queue), char count, first 120 chars of text.

Do not edit code. Do not commit. Buffer credentials come from tbcc/.env via load_tbcc_dotenv.

Milestone posts use outcome language only — never disclose scheduler internals, queue names, or proprietary architecture.
